title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for Private deployments
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private require enforced KMS region residency for keys used by private control planes and on-prem components. RBAC v2 must be able to express and enforce a policy that pins KMS usage to allowed regions, and every KMS access must emit audit logs with the region and key metadata. This PR implements enforcement and audit hooks for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and wires the behavior into the private installer and observability stack.

What this PR does: 1) Adds region-pinning rules to RBAC v2 policy model and enforcer with configuration toggles (audit-only, enforce). 2) Emits structured audit events on any KMS operation including: actor, principal, resource (key id), requested region, resolved region, policy decision, and reason. 3) Integrates region residency checks into the Private installer (Helm/template changes) so customers deploying with KMS-residency=true have the correct config baked into control plane components. 4) Adds integration tests that simulate cross-region key usage and verifies audit logs + enforcement behavior. 5) Documentation updates for ops detailing migration steps and rollout notes.

Notes: default mode is "audit-only" for 2 weeks before enforcement; rollout is controlled via feature flag and can be toggled per-tenant in Dedicated/Private. See linked Linear items for rollout checklist and monitoring playbook.

review_comments: Ava Collins: Overall looks solid. Two requests: (1) make the audit event schema stable (field names + types) and document it, (2) add a small metric for enforcement_denied_count for alerting.
Priya Shah: Good catches. I added audit schema docs and increment a new metric enforcement_denied_total in enforcer. See commit a8d9e4b and b2f4c3a.

Diego Ramirez: Integration tests passed locally, but the e2e flaked on the first CI run due to test timeouts when the simulated KMS endpoint responded slowly. Please add retries/backoff in the test harness.
Priya Shah: Added backoff and increased timeouts for the simulated KMS in tests. Rerunning CI.
Liam O'Connor: Security scan reported a transitive dependency with a minor advisory. Not blocker for merge but please open a follow-up to upgrade once upstream publishes a patch.
Priya Shah: Filed ENG-9512 to track the dependency bump. Marking as non-blocking for this rollout.
discussion_summary: Reviews requested small additions (audit schema docs, metric) and test hardening. CI initially flaky (e2e) due to simulated KMS latency; fixed with retries. Security scan produced a low-risk advisory tracked separately. Reviewers approved after fixes.
